commands:
set -euo pipefail
git fetch origin
git checkout integration/c6-s3-i2c-20260903
git reset --hard origin/integration/c6-s3-i2c-20260903
[ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "a5ad4d5cf5d9faf8c12de571ea088a4b6e2893e3" ]
printf '%s\n' '=== repo test/app layout ==='
find . -maxdepth 3 -type f \( -name 'CMakeLists.txt' -o -name 'idf_component.yml' -o -name 'sdkconfig.defaults' \) | sort
printf '%s\n' '=== ezbee endpoint/cluster creation APIs ==='
grep -R -n -E 'create_.*endpoint|endpoint.*create|cluster.*create|attr.*list|attribute.*add|endpoint.*register|device.*register' managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include/ezbee | head -n 240 || true
printf '%s\n' '=== reporting/attribute/command server APIs ==='
grep -R -n -E 'report.*attr|set.*attr|attribute.*set|cmd.*handler|command.*handler|on_off|level|temperature|humidity|occupancy|power_config|poll_control' managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include/ezbee/zcl | head -n 320 || true
printf '%s\n' '=== role/network config APIs ==='
grep -R -n -E 'end.?device|ED_CONFIG|network.*steer|bdb.*steer|start.*commission|role|sleep' managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include/ezbee | head -n 240 || true
printf '%s\n' '=== relevant header names ==='
find managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include/ezbee -type f | grep -E '/(af|bdb|zcl|zdo|secur)/|endpoint|device' | sort | head -n 260
